statement: For any finite k-block cube with m coordinates per block, any real test g, and the chain biases w_s whose first block is sX0 and whose remaining blocks are independent of s, with bounded factors, h_g(s)=E_U F_g(w_s(U)) is a polynomial in s of degree at most m. Coefficients are integrable bounded functions before averaging, and hprime(s)=sum_a E[X0(a) partial_(0,a) F_g(w_s)].
why_needed: Makes differentiation under expectation a finite algebraic operation and removes an unnecessary analytic interchange from the exposition.
route_note: Ordinary proof only; source uses its existing analytic derivative route. No new declaration proposed or compiled.

statement: For every natural k≥2 and natural t≥13669*k^2, Lvalue k t < R(P k t). More sharply, t≥ceil(54675*k^2/4) suffices. The frozen mValue t is4^t and the initial error is1/3.
why_needed: Supplies a simple all-t threshold directly from the current sharp uniform theorem, replacing the long four-term route in the main exposition.
proposed_lean:
-- Proposed interface only; NOT elaborated or compiled in this return.
-- Available imports would include QuarticQuery.ForrelationLower.Uniform.
theorem QuarticQuery.lvalue_lt_R_sharp_explicit
    (k t : Nat) (hk : 2 <= k) (ht : 13669 * k ^ 2 <= t) :
    QuarticQuery.Lvalue k t < QuarticQuery.R (QuarticQuery.P k t)
route_note: Use forrelation_lower_uniform_sharp and log_four_k_m_le; 4*13669=54676>54675. Existing lvalue_lt_R_explicit uses3499200*k², so do not label this exact threshold currently checked.

statement: For n≥1, integer d≥1,r≥1, any deterministic tree with arbitrary real leaf labels in[-1,1] and depth≤d, any coordinate biases|mu_i|≤1/2 and any family of distinct r-subsets, sum_J|partial_J F_g(mu)|≤(16rd ln(4n))^(r/2)+2^-r. Consequently F33 holds for such trees and finite convex mixtures with a uniform cap.
why_needed: Records the exact extra scope of the ordinary proof, instead of silently identifying it with the local two-output Boolean-tree encoding.
route_note: The proof uses only the bounded real value at each terminal leaf. Current source takes QueryTree with v:Bool→Real; this broader formulation has no separately named checked Lean declaration.
